notes.title: A brand new patch 1.1.2 is released!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Dieslpunk Builders![/h1]

We only recently left Early Access and published the incredible patch 1.1.0 (and the less impressive but still important patch 1.1.1). But we're not slowing down! We have a brand new patch for today which should greatly improve your experience. [b]Check out the changelog below:[/b]

[list]
[*] New buildings are added to the 'Fortification' tab in Battle Simulator, including new turrets, barriers, and structures to destroy.
[*] Turrets placed in Battle Simulator no longer sink into the ground.
[*] Enemy vehicles in Endless Mode won't spawn if there's an obstacle in the way.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the Endless Mode to (ironically) never end, even after defeat.
[*] Players are now given a bigger budget when constructing their first flying vehicle in the Campaign Mode.
[*] The base defense missions on the first map of the Campaign Mode are now easier and unlock more modules.
[*] Performance is now a bit better on the first four maps.
[*] Vehicles will no longer be impaired by small rocks or debris, making it a lot easier to traverse difficult terrain!
[/list]

These new changes should make it a lot easier for new players to start playing Dieselpunk Wars. We're also very excited by the recent additions to the Battle Simulator. You can see an example of what you can do with these new structures by[b] downloading our scenario[/b]:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2497661488

You don't need to download any vehicles to check it out. Just subscribe to this scenario on the Steam Workshop, launch the game, start a Battle Simulator on the Valley map and have some fun storming an enemy position!

Did you prepare a scenario you wish to share with your friends? Then all you need to do is [b]post it via Steam Workshop![/b] You can do this by doing the following steps:
[olist]
[*] Once you're done creating a scenario in Battle Simulator, click on the Save/Load button near the top left corner of the screen.
[*] Name your scenario and press "Save".
[*] Click on the recently saved scenario so that it's highlighted with a green frame.
[*] Press the "Publish to Steam" button and wait for a few seconds while the scenario is being uploaded.
[*] Once your scenario is on the Steam Workshop, you will receive a notification. You can then add a description to your scenario using the Steam interface.
[/olist]

Thank you for your feedback over the last few days! Most of these recent improvements were made in response to our wonderful community and your valuable comments. We hope that with this new build you'll have even more fun playing Dieselpunk Wars!

With regards
[b]Image Power team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/952240/Dieselpunk_Wars/

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is out! Check out the changelog!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/c79bb06b97636a60b3ae5d1f0799f28fd4eb4066.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello Dieselpunk Builders![/h2]

As you have probably noticed, Dieselpunk Wars officially left Early Access on the 13th of May. We would like to thank everybody who joined us for the celebration during our release live stream. If you missed it, you can watch a VOD of the live stream here:
[previewyoutube=2MyuRhLfOvs;full][/previewyoutube]

When Dieselpunk Wars left Early Access, we also released the long-awaited patch 1.1.0. Soon after, we also launched a hotfix 1.1.1, addressing some issues with scenario sharing on Steam Workshop. We have been talking about these updates for weeks before the release but we never did share complete patch notes. This post is here to fix that!

[h2]Check out the changelog below:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added new functionality that allows scenario sharing via Steam Workshop.
[*] Created a new tab "Fortifications" in Battle Simulator, which allows the players to add buildings to Battle Simulator.
[*] Reworked Battle Simulator UI to work with new functionalities.
[*] A vehicle can now be designated as a "Player Vehicle" in the Battle simulator.
[*] Vessels can now be marked as targets for the Player Vehicle.
[*] Added a button to copy a selected vehicle in Battle Simulator ('E' by default).
[*] It's now possible to plan move orders for AI-controlled vehicles in the Battle Simulator.
[/list]
[hr][/hr] 
[h3]Developer comment:[/h3]
[i]Simply put, all of the above features allow you to create your own missions in Battle Simulator and share them with your friends via Steam Workshop. Scenario sharing works similarly to vehicle sharing. When you start a scenario in which one of the vehicles is a "Player Vehicle", you will take control of the chosen vehicle instead of the usual battle simulation. Your task, as a player, will be to either destroy marked targets or defeat every vehicle on the opposing teams.

As a scenario creator, you can set up elaborate battle plans, position enemy vehicles behind heavy fortifications, and prepare patrol routes for the AI. And then order the player to destroy a heavily guarded convoy or break into a fortified facility. And as a player, all you have to do is download that scenario, open it in Battle Simulator, and have fun!

Just remember that if you share a scenario with custom-made vehicles, you need to publish those vehicles via Steam Workshop too. Otherwise, other players won't be able to use your scenario.[/i]
[hr][/hr] 
[h2]Now, for the rest of the changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new map called "Valley", perfect for large-scale vehicles and for custom scenarios in Battle Simulator.
[*] New blocks were added, including new viewports and Detachable Joints, which you can use to split your vehicle into smaller pieces or merge a few vehicles into one larger vessel.
[*] Improved vehicle physics.
[*] It's now possible to modify physics settings, including gravity or air drag, in the Creative Mode.
[*] Rotors now have an additional function, which allows them to be controlled by a mouse (this can be enabled individually for each rotor in Build Mode).
[*] Translations have been improved, big thanks to our community for feedback and suggestions regarding these changes!
[*] And many, many bugfixes...
[/list]

We've discussed individual parts of this changelog in the days leading up to the patch's release. For more detailed information on any of them, please check out our previous Steam announcements. And if there is anything else that you want to ask us about, feel free to reach out to us in the comments or on our official Discord server.

We can't wait to see the scenarios you come up with!

With regards
[b]Image Power team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/952240/Dieselpunk_Wars/

notes.title: Dieselpunk Wars leaves Early Access tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/c79bb06b97636a60b3ae5d1f0799f28fd4eb4066.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Dieselpunk Builders![/h1]

We are just one day away from the final release! We can’t wait to show you guys the final result of our work so today we're going to talk about not one, not two, but three new features! This will also conclude our list of big changes planned for patch 1.1.0 that will go live once Dieselpunk Wars leaves early access.

Before we start, check out our latest trailer for a sneak peek of the upcoming changes!
[previewyoutube=BWZQzYLd3sw;full][/previewyoutube]

Exciting, isn't it? Now, let's talk about the final three features.

[h2]New Map[/h2]

Your prayers have been answered! We added a new map based on your feedback, perfect for testing out your biggest creations on a large battlefield! The map features wide, open plains, woods, small hills, as well as two small but relatively deep lakes. There are few rocks or cliffs and in general, your vehicles shouldn't be hindered by difficult terrain. This map is built for speed! There are also no structures on the new map - we felt that adding any buildings would be a limitation for any scenarios you would want to create. Instead, you have total freedom to add as many fortifications in the Battle Simulator mode as you like! And if you're not sure how then check out our last update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/425a04791f1e4c80ddbd3fc876572e822ce0808a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Copy/Paste in Battle Simulator[/h2]

Did you create a really cool vehicle for your Battle Simulator scenario and wish to add more of them? In patch 1.1.0 you can simply press E to create a copy of your currently selected vehicle. All to maximize your efficiency! Play the game how you like it and explore all of the possibilities. 

[h2]The ability to share player-made scenarios via Steam Workshop[/h2]

This is our biggest new feature and one that we were most anxious to reveal! Many of the other features we talked about - the new map, battle simulator improvements, and so on - were made just to make better use of this incredible new functionality!

It works just like sharing your vehicles, by utilizing Steam Workshop. All you need to do is design your own scenario, fill it with vehicles, fortifications, and targets. Once you're satisfied, just share your work with other players so they can give your scenario a try! Remember to mark one of the vehicles as a player vehicle for a more immersive experience. And if you added any custom vehicles to your scenario, make sure to share them on the Steam Workshop too!

We believe that our wonderful community (that means you!) will create many epic and challenging battles and that our Steam Workshop page will soon be filled with interesting challenges. Come up with a challenging battle plan and see how your friends adapt to it!

[h1]We are almost there![/h1]

Let us know what you think about this update. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/wgZA6EA9]Discord server[/url] and stay in touch with our upcoming releases. See you there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/952240/Dieselpunk_Wars/

notes.title: New Feature Announced!
notes.content:
[url=https://i.imgur.com/dejdkpJ.jpg][img]https://i.imgur.com/dejdkpJ.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Hello, engineers![/h1]

We know you're waiting for more news about the upcoming patch 1.1.0 and so, we prepared a special treat for you: two new features instead of one! We hope you're as excited as we are!

Firstly, something big. We implemented a function that allows the players to add structures in the Battle Simulator mode! Previously, you would have to either make use of pre-existing structures that are already on a map or create an immobile vehicle to act as a structure. You can still do that, of course, but you also have the option to add some of the buildings that you've seen on our maps.

And that isn't all! Adding buildings is fun but what's even cooler is an ability to specify targets in Battle Simulator. And by targets, we mean key objectives that have to be achieved. Additionally, you can designate a vehicle to be a player vehicle by default - meaning that when you start a battle simulation, you will immediately gain control of that vehicle. So you can easily create complex scenarios and play them out. Pretty cool, right?

[url=https://i.imgur.com/5zUqz7M.jpg][img]https://i.imgur.com/5zUqz7M.jpg[/img][/url]

Secondly, a quality of life improvement that many of you have asked for. You now can control rotors with your mouse instead of using a keyboard! It might be a small thing but improving the controls is something we've been doing ever since Dieselpunk Wars was released. After all, we don't want the controls to get in the way of either building or destroying your opponents.

That is all for this update! Did you enjoy it? We have even better features planned for the upcoming patch 1.1.0 so stay tuned! You can share your excitement with us on our Discord server too! We would love to see you there :D

[h1]Best regards,
Image Power Team[/h1]

notes.title: The AI Upgrade is almost here!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JbmpUrn.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello, dieselpunk constructors![/h1]

It's about time we talk about the next feature to come with the long-awaited patch 1.1.0 and the exit from Steam Early Access. There are still a lot more features to cover so we're going to start posting these updates more frequently from now on. Make sure not to miss any of them!

This time around we need to talk about the "invisible" things that every patch needs. Fixes and improvements. They often go overlooked, hidden under the hood, but they are quite essential. Patch 1.1.0 will, of course, include a number of important improvements, big and small. Aside from reported bugs and issues detected by our QA team, the upcoming update will also improve the translations and AI. Thanks to our wonderful community we were able to track down certain inconsistencies in our translations that were previously unnoticed. Additionally, we calibrated the targeting AI, meaning that vehicles should have fewer issues shooting each other.

In the next update, we will talk about a new feature that was highly requested by our players! Stay tuned to find out what it is and discuss the upcoming update with other players on our official Discord channel!

Best regards,
Image Power Team

notes.title: It's official - Full Version of Dieselpunk Wars is coming to steam on 13 May!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/821018033237655593/831797592735481866/Art_FULL_REALISE.jpg?width=1440&height=656[/img]

[h1] It is official [/h1]

[b] Dieselpunk Wars [/b] full release will make its way to Steam servers on the 13th of May. It is our most awaited project of quarter one 2021. Time to battle with our tanks, airships, and submarines! We have never been more ready to supply you with the most interesting machine parts you can find on market. [i]Big, big thanks[/i] to our loyal backers from Kickstarter. This game would not be made if not the support from you. ːgemː

[h1] Something for you from us [/h1]

So far we've made many changes in the game. The campaign mode has been improved and many bugs have been patched. Without your suggestions, the game would not run as smoothly as it does now.  From now on we will publish additional information about the upcoming premiere every couple of days, starting today. 

The first feature of the full game is improved physics! We've been listening to your feedback regarding our machines. You've said that they felt not heavy enough so we changed them. That was a very hard task as that feeling is usually subjective so we've done our best to make them feel as real as it gets. The game never felt that good.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/821013897804513322/831532658550767626/PATCHE_FINAL_3_1.png?width=1201&height=676[/img]

[h1] The game only gets better [/h1] 

We do want to spoil you too much so the Final Release upgrades will be shown every couple of days. The 1.1.0 patch will be the biggest of all updates we've made so far. In few days we will update the infographic shown above.

Your voice helped us maneuver Dieselpunk Wars towards becoming a better game. Our final production has been fueled by your ideas and suggestions. We are certainly looking forward to publishing the final part of our production on the 13 May. 

Stay tuned and join our discord to discover new possibilities of our game as soon as possible! - https://discord.gg/wgZA6EA9 ːdealwithitː

 [b] Thank you for playing,

notes.title: Dieselpunk Wars contest winners + Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/8b07c414fb679401ef1d7ae98d0042b74adb575c.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, dieselpunk constructors![/h2]

Our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/952240/announcements/detail/3033707388030052024]competition[/url] has ended and we’ve got the winners!

Just to remind you, the theme this time was crazy racing machines! We wanted to see machines that can ride on the ground, soar through the skies, or cut through the waves.

We are happy to announce that we decided to give out [b]three awards[/b] instead of just one! It was simply too difficult to pick a single winner and we really, really wanted to showcase more than just one competitor.

So without further ado... The main winner of the contest is [b]Helios[/b]! The second place goes to [b]WeirdFuturisticAircraft[/b] and the third place to [b]Masterscrewer[/b]. All three constructors will get their fancy rewards!

[h2]Here are the winning screenshots:[/h2]

[b]Helios[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/d6551d40a2b03046da9a586d4ac6c6db51e56abb.jpg[/img]

[b]WeirdFuturisticAircraft[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/1307edf2580e90c005c32fee143dbcb6e295805a.jpg[/img]

[b]Masterscrewer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/7d81400cd3412e540fe2d5e8f18777dafa32f8fa.jpg[/img]

You can check the rest of them here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/952240/screenshots/?snr=2_9_100003_&p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent

Congratulations to our community members! We will send you a [b]Dieselpunk Wars key[/b] soon and assign a [b]Skillful Builder role on our Discord server[/b].

Thank you for participating and we encourage you to take a part in our contests in the future. Your skills are amazing and your imagination is impressive. Don’t waste your potential!

[h2]New update![/h2]

We are also happy to inform you that we released patch 1.0.5. Our main focus was improving the Endless Mode which we still weren't quite satisfied with. [b]Check out the changelog below[/b]:

💥 The number of enemies present in the Endless Mode is limited to 5 at a time. If more than five enemies are meant to spawn during a single wave, these enemies will wait until the player destroys one of the opponents. Thanks to this, the player will not be instantly destroyed by a swarm of powerful enemies on higher levels.
💥 It's no longer possible to trigger a double wave spawn by repeatedly pressing the button to start the next wave.
💥 Enemy waves are more consistent. Before, it was possible for more enemies to appear in wave 4 than in wave 5. Now, this shouldn't happen.
💥 We increased the probability of new weapon unlocks after defeating each wave.
💥 If the player is destroyed in the Endless Mode, they will no longer keep access to their previously unlocked parts after restarting the mode.
💥 The module selection hotbar is now reset after the Endless Mode restarts.
💥 We also made various other improvements to the Endless Mode's code so there shouldn't be any further issues with enemy waves not spawning in later stages of this mode.

In the next patch, we will focus on YOUR suggestions. We've been listening to your feedback and we're working on implementing some new mechanics into the game, as well as improving some of the old ones. [b]Stay tuned![/b]

[b]Take care,
Image Power Team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/952240/Dieselpunk_Wars/

notes.title: Patch notes and Dieselpunk Wars contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/e584ecdbcf32ce21446c57ec99ec40ef8e5a5fac.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We've got something for you - check out the latest update to [b]Dieselpunk Wars[/b]. As always, thank you for your support and feedback, you are the best. 

[h2]Patch 1.0.4:[/h2]

💥 Fixed an error that would cause the enemies to stop spawning after wave 6 of the Endless Mode;
💥 Improved Great Tracks module behavior;
💥 Camouflage blocks now properly receive shadows;
💥 Text Plates can now be saved;
💥 Added a new Exhaust Pipe module;
💥 Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause Steel, Hard Steel, and Titan modules to spawn, save, and load in their damaged state.
💥 Enemies spawned in Creative Mode now always despawn after destroying the player.
💥 Toolbar improvements, module selection panels 2-4 will no longer be overwritten by panel #1.

Please keep giving us feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/952240/discussions/]Steam forum[/url] and in your Steam reviews as it will help with future installments.

[h2]And a contest![/h2]

We are constantly impressed by your vivid imagination and ability to create extraordinary machines. 

Therefore, we want to encourage you to take part in the construction competition. The prize is an additional Dieselpunk Wars key, which you can give to a friend. Additionally, we can grant you a special “Skillful Builder” role on our Discord server.

💥 [b]Competition theme - a crazy racing machine! Anything goes, it can ride on
the ground, soar through the skies, or cut through the waves.[/b] 💥

To enter the contest, all you have to do is [b]design a cool machine[/b] that fits the theme and post a screenshot of the game in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/952240/screenshots/]Screenshots tab[/url] of the Dieselpunk Wars Steam page. You can use the Photo Mode to take a screenshot, which is activated by pressing the F11 key while in-game.

Important! [b]Screenshots of competing machines must be labeled "[u]Dieselpunk Wars racing machines contest[/u]".[/b]

You have 2 weeks! The competition will end on February 25. We will reveal the winner shortly after. [b]You can upload up to 5 screenshots that will take part in the contest![/b] We reserve the right to publish the selected entries on our social media and Steam page.

Understood? Great! Let's go! Wish you luck, and can't wait for what your imagination will bring this time.

[b]Thank you for playing,

notes.title: Dieselpunk Wars Patch 1.0.2. - bugfixes and Endless Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/6ac0dd6d273d866b0d7f6e86366adbcf3138ccf9.png[/img][h1]Hello, dieselpunk constructors! [/h1]

It's time for a major update to [b]Dieselpunk Wars[/b]!

Now you'll be able to play [b]Endless Mode[/b] - the mode where you get to fight waves of increasingly powerful enemies. Do you want to taste dieselpunk survival? Here it comes!

We also added new parts and lots of bugfixes. Further information below. 

[h2]Improvements and bug fixes[/h2]

[b]-> Added the Endless Mode![/b]
We're proud to introduce our fourth game mode to Dieselpunk Wars! This new game mode will let you face waves of progressively tougher enemies. You can fight on any of the four maps! After defeating each wave, your build limit will increase and you will have a chance to upgrade your vehicle with new, random parts. Give this new mode a try and let us know what your high score is!

[b]-> Added 15 new parts![/b] 
You can now create new vehicles using 2 new decorative modules, design new wing setups with 10 more wing parts, make a more aerodynamic vessel with a new hull block, and power your airships and airplanes with 2 new, more powerful propellers! You can check the full list of new parts below;

💥 Improved flying physics, airplanes should now be more stable and wing setup should have a greater impact on how well a vehicle behaves in the air;
💥 Activating field repairs (backspace key by default) will now slightly move your vehicle in the direction you're pointing at, which should help when you get stuck;
💥 Skill Tree and Block Selection Window popouts should no longer display after you dismiss them;
💥 You can now assign weapon groups to numeric keypad;
💥 Fixed the reversed control layout for piston modules;
💥 Gyroscopes should now operate on 100% of their power by default;
💥 Fixed a rare bug, which caused vehicles to flip after activating field repairs;
💥 Added a new, more intuitive camera mode for the Build Mode! You can activate this alternative camera mode by pressing the "/" button while you're in Build Mode. This new camera mode has different controls. You can move your camera around your vehicle by holding the right mouse button and moving your mouse, you can also use the WASD keys for the same effect. The camera will always stay focused on your vehicle.

[b]Full list of new modules:[/b]
Deck Passage
Passage with Golden Balustrade
Sloped Wing 
Front Wing 
Flat Wing 
Flat Long Wing 
Wing Back Flap
Front Wing End
Wing Middle End
Curved Front Wing 
Curved Wing Middle
Curved Wing 
Quad Long Triangle 3
Airplane Propeller 
Big Airplane Propeller 

[h3]Our community is the best[/h3]

This patch wouldn’t be possible without your support! Your comments and reviews on the Steam forum as well as discussions on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/a6hEJVy]Discord channel[/url] help us focus on what’s most important to the community. You’re helping us make Dieselpunk Wars a better game! Thank you

[b]And we highly encourage you to continue sharing your opinions and suggestions – let us know what you would like to see in Dieselpunk Wars![/b]

tags.feature: 💥 It's now possible to edit your vehicle during scouting missions in the Campaign;

notes.title: All languages implemented, Steam Workshop hotfix, and backer surveys sent
notes.content:
We like to keep you on your toes so we prepared a new update for you!

First of all, great news to everyone who struggles with English and wanted to see their game translated to their native language! We finally implemented all remaining translations for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275590/Dieselpunk_Wars_Prologue/]Dieselpunk Wars Prologue[/url] and now you can enjoy our game in German, French, and simplified Chinese! This brings the total of supported languages to seven, not a bad number!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/5d7be9274dd1d0db1e6c587964d306e3c7bc22f0.jpg[/img]

In other news, we prepared a small hotfix for everyone playing Dieselpunk Wars Prologue. While this list of changes might not look as impressive as the last one, you have to take into account that we're currently hard at work on Dieselpunk Wars' campaign. Don't worry, we'll continue supporting the Prologue as well as we can and you can expect larger patches once we have more time available! Here are the patch notes:

Improvements:
- Added language support for German, French, and simplified Chinese.
- Tweaked popout background to improve readability.
- You can now update your Steam Workshop vehicles instead of having to upload new versions as separate files.

Fixes:
- Fixed the "Cut through the waves" achievement which wasn't awarded correctly.

Finally, we have one more news for you, although you might already be aware of it - we recently sent out backer surveys to all of our Kickstarter backers! Make sure you check your emails, specifically the one connected to your Kickstarter account. Take a look at the spam folder if you don't see the survey and contact us if it doesn't arrive within the next few days.

Thank you for your continuous support! We'll do our best so that Dieselpunk Wars can live up to your expectations![url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275590/Dieselpunk_Wars_Prologue/] Check out the Prologue version[/url] if you haven't already, as some great vehicles have already been constructed over there! We'll leave you with a little teaser of what one of our players has made ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/6d9b58b84b582afed8e69058207867e5a96e6247.png[/img]

Until next time!

notes.title: New patch, progress on the campaign, and backer surveys
notes.content:
Hello there, we prepared a new update for you!

Dieselpunk Wars Prologue launched last week and now everybody can give it a shot! We learned a lot from that and we would like to thank everybody who posted their feedback or Steam reviews! Thanks to your aid we now know exactly what we need to focus on before the full version of Dieselpunk Wars launches. We already started working on incorporating your feedback into both, the full game and the Prologue. As a result, we have a new patch ready for you!

[b]Improvements[/b]:[list]
[*] Added additional quick selection bars to the module panel at the bottom of the screen - you can now toggle between four separate panels and assign different parts to each of them!
[*] Small tweak to vehicle maneuverability, in preparation for future improvements.
[*] You can now rotate blocks using the < and > keys (in addition to the mouse wheel).
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]:[list]
[*] Added missing lines of text in the Russian translation.
[*] Fixed an issue where English translation would sometimes appear instead of the Russian translation.
[*] Camera will no longer move when you type something into the search bar in Build Mode.
[*] Mouse cursor should no longer display when moving the camera in Photo Mode (F11).
[*] Vehicles can now properly aim and fire at targets above them.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]:[list]
[*] We removed the option to change the game language from the main menu due to the numerous issues it caused. You can still set your language via the properties on Steam. Simply right-click on the game in your Steam library, select properties, go to the "Language" tab, and choose the language you want to use.
[/list]

As for what else is happening in our studio - our team is now focused on finishing the campaign, balancing individual modules, and designing enemy vehicles for the player to face. It's a lot of tedious work but it's nothing we can't handle! We're also working on the behavior of enemy bosses and the way they appear in the cutscenes. We don't want to spoil anything but we might as well show you concept art for one of the most important vehicles in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/6f3b7f6ecf6cc591bf4ee7efb05ad0617505de2e.jpg[/img]

Finally, you might be wondering about your backer rewards. Don't worry, we will send you backer surveys regarding your rewards within the coming days! Some of the rewards are already worked on but we will need your input to implement the rest of them. We will also use these surveys to gather your names (or nicknames) to add to the game's credits. So keep an eye out for any new messages you receive!

That's everything for this update. We hope you're doing well! Good luck in your gaming adventures and remember to give Dieselpunk Wars Prologue a try if you haven't done so already ;)
